reason: A is better grounded in Ni–Ti-containing FCC HEAs: controlled ordered precipitation offers a plausible, directly testable route to elevated-temperature strengthening, whereas B extrapolates Mo-induced σ precipitation from a compositionally and structurally different BCC alloy and risks embrittlement.
